div.head: CHn cor 3.3
div.ab: Et si, mortuo marito, uxor eius remanserit et sine liberis fuerit, dotem suam et maritationem habebit; et eam non dabo marito nisi secundum uelle suum.
Et si, mortuo viro, uxor eius remanserit et sine liberis fuerit, dotem suam et maritationem habebit, et eam non dabo marito nisi secundum velle suum.
And if, on the death of her husband, a wife is left and has no children, she shall have her marriage-settlement and dowry, and I shall not bestow her in marriage except in accordance with her wishes.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 278–279 (text and translation); Robertson's 3 § 2 (Liebermann's 3,3).; Liebermann’s text added from Gesetze I p. 521, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)
